A '''conduit''' is an underwater beacon. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its recipe because the heart of the sea is its [[Electrum Alloy|electrum alloy]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Eight nautilus shells around a [[Stable Void|stable void]] make a conduit; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/conduit.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
